provenance: Pulled by fetch_ramp_index.py from https://ramp.com/data/ai-index on 2026-10-14 11:39 (inline Next.js flight payload; legacy CSVs regenerated from raw/). Earlier vintages: CSVs supplied by Felipe 2026-08-20 (spend) and 2026-09-02 (model share), archived under vintages/.

adoption.definition: share of businesses with an observed payment for an AI product or service in the month (card + invoice/ACH); Census = Business Trends and Outlook Survey, question re-worded Nov-2025

spend_share.definition: AI spend as a share of total payment volume (TPV) on Ramp, %

spend_extra.note: p90/p99 = the 90th/99th percentile company; top10/top1 = median INSIDE that cohort; winsorized_weighted = spend-weighted mean with the top 1% capped

tokens.price_note: token_cost_usd_7d / token_count_7d x 1e6 -- blended $ per million tokens, trailing 7 days, sampled on week-end dates
tokens.definition: Ramp Token Spend Management product sample: usage + billing imported from connected AI providers. Ramp: a SAMPLE of its businesses, 'not representative of Ramp's total AI spend volume, though results are directionally similar'.
